name: VoiceStudio
description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
one_liner: A free, offline app that clones voices, dubs videos into other languages, and turns text into natural speech, so you stop paying a cloud company by the minute.
buyer: A course creator or small podcast studio currently paying a monthly cloud voice-AI bill who wants that recurring cost gone for good.
business_use_cases: A course creator dubs their English video course into a dozen languages overnight and sells the same course in new markets without hiring voice actors.
A podcast network generates consistent host-voice ad reads and episode intros locally instead of booking studio time for every episode.
A backlist publisher turns out-of-print books into narrated audiobooks that never sold enough copies to justify paying a human narrator.

money_ideas.idea: Run a hosted dubbing and narration service for creators who don't want to self-host, charging per minute of audio produced.
Sell a managed, simple upload-and-download web front end to small studios and course platforms.

steal_this: Build a weekend 'dub your YouTube channel into 5 languages' service for small creators, powered by this tool on the backend, charging a flat fee per video.
